{"id":"persona-vvs2.6","title":"getuid has no Windows analogue; the account identity is a SID","description":"Four sites call libc::getuid: hire-grpc/src/service.rs, server.rs, socket.rs, consumer_attest.rs, plus hire-attestors/src/unix.rs. On Windows the account is a SID, not a uid.

TWO DIFFERENT USES, and only one of them is about identity:
  - unix.rs uses getuid()/getpwuid_r to ASSERT AN IDENTITY -- the unix-account
    attestor, iaa1. The Windows equivalent is a separate attestor keyed on the
    SID, not a port of this one, and it should be filed as such if wanted.
  - server.rs, socket.rs, service.rs and consumer_attest.rs use it for PATHS
    AND PEER CHECKS. Those follow the transport and consumer-attestation work
    and mostly disappear into persona-vvs2.1 and .3.

Do not fold the two. The SPIFFE path for a Windows account is a schema question -- SPEC-HIRE's ID schema currently has no SID form -- and an unseeded trust domain fails ValidateJWTSVID, which is the same trap the unix-account source hit when it had to publish into ssh.local rather than a domain of its own.

Low priority because it is downstream of everything else and because a Windows box with no other source would issue an iaa1 SID credential, which is the least interesting thing hired can do.","acceptance_criteria":"Path and peer uses resolved through the transport abstraction; any SID-based identity assertion filed and specified separately, with a trust domain that is actually seeded.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-15T21:01:30.831135639Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-09-15T21:01:30.831135639Z","labels":["windows","portability"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"persona-vvs2.6","depends_on_id":"persona-vvs2","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-09-15T21:01:30.856586981Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
